module: Flowgraph node 'Select Garage Vehicle' (once_instant category, author BeamNG) for the garage-to-garage mission. Randomly picks a model/config from mission.vehicleOptions (calling mission:generateVehicleOptions if needed), avoiding configs already used until exhausted. Outputs: impulse 'loaded', 'model', 'config', 'name' (display name).
notes: The local function getAllAvailableConfigs turns the options into a list {model, config, name}.
When all configs have been used, usedConfigs is emptied and math.randomseed(os.time()) is called again.
On error (no mission, no options), the node logs an error and does nothing.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Initializes the selection, state=1 and usedConfigs.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the selection and the outputs to zero.

resetData.desc: Resets the selection, state=1 and the outputs to zero (usedConfigs is kept).

work.desc: state 1: picks an unused config, records it in usedConfigs, writes model/config/name, loaded=true, goes to state 2. state 2: loaded=false.
